faqs_en.a: Passwords use the browser's cryptographic random API (crypto.getRandomValues) with rejection sampling to remove modulo bias. Everything is generated locally and never sent over the network or logged.

faqs_en.q: How is every character type guaranteed?
faqs_en.a: When length allows, each password first takes one character from every enabled type, fills the rest randomly, then shuffles, ensuring uppercase, lowercase, digits and symbols each appear at least once.

faqs_en.q: How long should a password be?
faqs_en.a: At least 12 characters mixing multiple types is recommended. Use our entropy calculator to quantify strength; above 60 bits is considered very strong.

faqs_es.q: ¿Cómo se garantiza cada tipo de carácter?
faqs_es.a: Cuando la longitud lo permite, cada contraseña toma primero un carácter de cada tipo activado, rellena el resto al azar y mezcla todo, asegurando mayúsculas, minúsculas, dígitos y símbolos.
